definition
	CLUSTER[at0000.1] matches {    -- Palpation of the cervix
		items cardinality matches {1..*; unordered} matches {
			ELEMENT[at0001.1] matches {    -- System or structure examined
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::at0.1]    -- Cervix
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0012] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Body site
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			allow_archetype CLUSTER[at0011] occurrences matches {0..*} matches {    -- Structured body site
				include
					archetype_id/value matches {/openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER\.anatomical_location(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*\.v1|openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER\.anatomical_location_circle(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*\.v1|openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER\.anatomical_location_relative(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*\.v2/}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0003] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Clinical description
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			allow_archetype CLUSTER[at0004] occurrences matches {0..*} matches {    -- Examination findings
				include
					archetype_id/value matches {/.*/}
			}
			allow_archetype CLUSTER[at0005] occurrences matches {0..*} matches {    -- Multimedia representation
				include
					archetype_id/value matches {/openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER\.media_file(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*\.v1/}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0006] occurrences matches {0..*} matches {    -- Clinical interpretation
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0007] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Comment
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			allow_archetype CLUSTER[at0008] occurrences matches {0..*} matches {    -- Examination not done
				include
					archetype_id/value matches {/openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER\.exclusion_exam(-[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*\.v1/}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.2] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Relative position
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::
							at0.3,    -- Anterior
							at0.4,    -- Normal
							at0.5,    -- Posterior
							at0.6,    -- Left
							at0.7]    -- Right
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.8] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Consistency
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::
							at0.9,    -- Firm
							at0.10,    -- Intermediate
							at0.11]    -- Soft
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.12] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Surface description
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.13] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Mobility
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.14] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Tenderness
				value matches {
					DV_TEXT matches {*}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.15] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Thickness
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::
							at0.16,    -- Thick
							at0.17,    -- Thin
							at0.18,    -- Paper-thin
							at0.19]    -- Oedematous
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.20] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Effacement
				value matches {
					DV_PROPORTION matches {
						numerator matches {|0.0..100.0|}
						type matches {2}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.21] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Cervical length
				value matches {
					C_DV_QUANTITY <
						property = <[openehr::122]>
						list = <
							["1"] = <
								units = <"cm">
								magnitude = <|0.0..10.0|>
							>
						>
					>
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.22] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Application to presenting part
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::
							at0.24,    -- Loose
							at0.25]    -- Tight
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.23] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Anterior lip presence
				value matches {
					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {
							[local::
							at0.26,    -- Present
							at0.27]    -- Absent
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.28] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- External os dilation
				value matches {
					C_DV_QUANTITY <
						property = <[openehr::122]>
						list = <
							["1"] = <
								units = <"cm">
								magnitude = <|0.0..10.0|>
							>
						>
					>
				}
			}
			ELEMENT[at0.29] occurrences matches {0..1} matches {    -- Internal os dilation
				value matches {
					C_DV_QUANTITY <
						property = <[openehr::122]>
						list = <
							["1"] = <
								units = <"cm">
								magnitude = <|0.0..10.0|>
							>
						>
					>
				}
			}
		}
	}

	details = <
		["de"] = <
			language = <[ISO_639-1::de]>
			purpose = <"*To record findings observed during palpation of the uterus, in both pregnant and non-pregnant individuals. (en)">
			keywords = <"*uterus, bimanual, palpation, examination, fundal height, Anteversion, Anteflexion, fetus,  foetus, baby, abdomen, vagina, pregnant, pregnancy. (en)", ...>
			copyright = <"© openEHR Foundation">
			use = <"*Use to record a narrative description and clinical interpretation of the findings observed only by palpation of the uterus, either from an abdominal or a vaginal approach.

This archetype has been specifically designed to be used in the 'Examination detail' SLOT within the CLUSTER.exam-abdomen, CLUSTER.exam-palpation-vagina or OBSERVATION.exam archetypes, but can also be used within other ENTRY or CLUSTER archetypes, where clinically appropriate.

Use to provide a framework in which CLUSTER archetypes can be nested in the 'Examination findings' SLOT to record additional structured physical examination findings - for example, a fetus.

The CLUSTER.exclusion_exam archetype can be nested within the 'Examination not done' SLOT to optionally record explicit details about the examination not being performed.

Use to incorporate the narrative descriptions of clinical findings within existing or legacy clinical systems into an archetyped format, using the 'Clinical Description' data element. (en)">
			misuse = <"*Not to be used when multiple modes are used simultaneously to examine a body system or anatomical structure, including inspection or auscultation. Use the CLUSTER.exam family of archetypes for this purpose.

		["ca"] = <
			language = <[ISO_639-1::ca]>
			purpose = <"Registrar les troballes observades durant l'examen físic del cos o estructura anatòmica.">
			use = <"S'utilitza per registrar les troballes observades durant l'examen físic del cos o estructura anatòmica.

Aquest arquetip ha estat dissenyat específicament per a ser utilitzat en el SLOT 'Examination detail' dins de l'OBSERVATION.exam o del SLOT \"Procedure detail\" dins de l'arquetip ACTION.procedure, però també es pot utilitzar dins d'altres arquetips ENTRY o CLUSTER, quan sigui clínicament apropiat. Les especialitzacions d'aquest arquetip s'utilitzaran per registrar els resultats de l'examen per a sistemes corporals identificats, estructures anatòmiques o llocs corporals més precisos. Cada especialització preservarà com a base l'estructura subjacent d'aquest arquetip general i s'ampliarà mitjançant l'addició d'elements específics al cos. Si no hi ha una especialització adequada disponible, utilitzeu aquest arquetip i identifiqueu el sistema o estructura que s'està examinant utilitzant l'element de dades \"Sistema o estructura examinada\" i la ubicació en el cos utilitzant l'element de dades \"lloc del cos\" o la RANURA \"lloc del cos estructurat\".

La interpretació de les troballes, per exemple 'No s'ha detectat cap anormalitat' o 'inflamació present moderada', es pot registrar utilitzant l'element de dades 'interpretació clínica'.

S'utilitza per proporcionar un marc en el qual els arquetips de CLUSTER poden ser afegits en el SLOT \"Troballes de l'examen\" per registrar resultats d'un examen físic estructurats addicionals.

L'arquetip CLUSTER.exclusion_exam es pot afegir dins del SLOT 'Examen no realitzat' per tal de registrar opcionalment detalls explícits sobre l'examen que no s'està realitzant.

Incorporar les descripcions narratives de les troballes clíniques dins dels sistemes clínics existents o llegats en un format arquetipat, utilitzant l'element de dades de \"Descripció clínica\".">
			misuse = <"No s'ha d'utilitzar per registrar la història clínica - utilitzar els arquetipis OBSERVATION i CLUSTER. Exemple: OBSERVATION.story i CLUSTER.symptom_sign.

No s'ha d'utilitzar per registrar els resultats d'un examen d'imatge - utilitzar la família d'arquetips CLUSTER.imaging_exam per a aquest propòsit.">
		>

definition

		items cardinality matches {1..*; unordered} matches {
			ELEMENT[at0001.1] matches {    -- System or structure examined

					DV_CODED_TEXT matches {
						defining_code matches {

	term_definitions = <
		["en"] = <
			items = <
				["at0000.1"] = <
					text = <"Examination of the uterus">
					description = <"Findings observed during the palpation of the uterus.">
				>
				["at0.1"] = <
					text = <"Length">
					description = <"The estimated length from the fundus to the cervix.">
					comment = <"Measured in centimetres.">
				>
				["at0.2"] = <
					text = <"Size estimation">
					description = <"Size estimation of the uterus.">
					comment = <"An estimation of uterine size based on physical examination, documented as either a narrative description or a comparative estimate related to size of a pregnant uterus, such as '10 weeks'. These comparisons refer to the typical uterine size at specific stages of pregnancy and provide a standardised reference framework. Alternatively, locally recognised size descriptors, such as 'orange' or 'tennis ball' may be added to the DV_TEXT data type in a template to support a predefined list of terms.">
				>
				["at0.3"] = <
					text = <"Fundal height">
					description = <"The vertical distance from the symphysis pubis to the top of the pregnant uterine fundus.">
					comment = <"Usually only possible in pregnancy after approximately 20 weeks of gestation. This can be recorded as the measured distance or by identifying the height of the uterine fundus relative to identifiable anatomical landmarks, such as  the pubic symphysis, umbilicus, xiphoid process).">
				>
				["at0.4"] = <
					text = <"Not palpable">
					description = <"Uterus is not palpable in the abdomen.">
				>
				["at0.5"] = <
					text = <"At public symphsis">
					description = <"The uterus is just palpable at the level of the symphysis pubis.">
				>
				["at0.6"] = <
					text = <"At umbilicus">
					description = <"The uterus is palpable at, or about, the level of the umbilicus.">
				>
				["at0.7"] = <
					text = <"At xiphisternum">
					description = <"The uterus is palpable at, or about, the level of the xiphisternum.">
				>
				["at0.12"] = <
					text = <"Mobility">
					description = <"The degree to which the uterus can be displaced during bimanual examination, reflecting its freedom of movement within the pelvis.">
				>
				["at0.13"] = <
					text = <"Mobile">
					description = <"The uterus moves freely in response to gentle pressure during bimanual palpation, without resistance or pain.">
				>
				["at0.14"] = <
					text = <"LImited">
					description = <"The uterus can be displaced on bimanual palpation but with some resistance or reduced range of motion.">
				>
				["at0.15"] = <
					text = <"Fixed">
					description = <"The uterus does not move or is unable to be displaced on bimanual palpation.">
				>
				["at0.8"] = <
					text = <"Tenderness">
					description = <"The presence or absence of pain elicited during bimanual palpation of the uterus.">
				>
				["at0.9"] = <
					text = <"Present">
					description = <"Pain is elicited on bimanual palpation of the uterus.">
				>
				["at0.10"] = <
					text = <"Absent">
					description = <"No pain is elicited on bimanual palpation of the uterus.">
				>
				["at0.11"] = <
					text = <"Tenderness decription">
					description = <"Narrative description about findings of pain or tenderness of the uterus.">
					comment = <"For e.g. Tenderness present on anterior uterine wall, elicited during bimanual palpation, described by the patient as sharp and localized.">
				>
				["at0.16"] = <
					text = <"Shape">
					description = <"The overall anatomical contour of the uterus as assessed during bimanual palpation.">
					comment = <"For eg. Normal pear-shaped uterus.">
				>
				["at0.17"] = <
					text = <"Consistency">
					description = <"Narrative description about the texture and firmness of the uterus.">
				>
				["at0.18"] = <
					text = <"Version">
					description = <"The orientation of the cervix relative to the vagina.">
				>
				["at0.19"] = <
					text = <"Anteverted">
					description = <"The cervix tilts forward toward the bladder.">
				>
				["at0.20"] = <
					text = <"Neutral">
					description = <"The cervix is roughly in line with the vagina.">
				>
				["at0.21"] = <
					text = <"Retroverted">
					description = <"The cervix tilts backward toward the rectum.">
				>
				["at0.22"] = <
					text = <"Flexion">
					description = <"The orientation of the vagina relative to the cervix.">
				>
				["at0.23"] = <

				>
